lights.headline: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
lights.summary: Multimodal large language models have advanced visual reasoning, but a controlled study on 22 benchmarks shows that simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains, indicating that tasks requiring grounded perception, external knowledge, and numerical measurements need more than internal reasoning.

lights.headline: Reinforcement Learning with Visually Attributable On-Policy Self-Distillation
lights.summary: Multimodal reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards provides reliable task-level supervision but limited guidance for localizing errors in visual reasoning; on‑policy self‑distillation adds dense token‑level corrections from a privileged teacher with an evidence‑centered visual view, though these corrections may conflate visual and textual errors.

lights.headline: CoopUQ: Robust Multi-Robot Social Navigation via Uncertainty-Aware Cooperative Forecasting
lights.summary: Reinforcement learning enables mobile robots to make fast navigation decisions in human‑shared environments, but extending single‑robot approaches to multi‑robot settings often fails to ensure safety and efficiency, especially under occlusions and out‑of‑distribution scenarios where individual robots may overlook risks or make inaccurate predictions.

claims.text: CoopUQ uses constrained multi-agent reinforcement learning to penalize navigation through predicted occupied or highly uncertain regions.

lights.headline: Where is Physical RSI capability from? An Observational Scaling Law of LLM-as-policy
lights.summary: The paper introduces PhysRSI‑eval to quantify physical recursive self‑improvement through a five‑axis metric and evaluates different VLMs on 18 manipulation tasks under a fixed interaction budget, analyzing mechanisms, scaling behavior, and generalization.
